content: IBus process_key_event(keyval, keycode, state): keyval is an X keysym already resolved through the active layout; keycode is hardware code; state carries modifier masks plus IBUS_RELEASE_MASK (bit 30) for releases. Return TRUE = consumed, FALSE = forwarded to app. Modifiers arrive as press/release events too. Known upstream bug ibus#2600: rapid shift-down+key sequences (~1ms) lose the Shift modifier through ibus (closed not-planned) - timing-sensitive modifier state races exist in the ibus path.
